urdu: کون سے پاکستانی رہنما کے دور میں معیشت کو "اسلامی" بنایا گیا تھا؟
english: During whose leadership was the Pakistani economy made "Islamic"?
roman_1: Kis Pakistani rehnuma ke dor mein maeeshat ko "Islami" banaya gaya tha?
roman_2: Kon se Pakistani leader ke dor mein economy ko "Islami" kiya gaya tha?
roman_3: Kis Pakistani leader ke doran maeeshat "Islami" banayi gayi thi?
